intro: Turn forgotten corners into statement spaces. With a sturdy base and tempered glass top, the Vegas adds elegance while giving you practical surface space for décor or daily use.

features.title: Built tough for life’s everyday demands
features.text: Work smarter, not harder. Our lightweight fibreglass design is easy to move and built to last—perfect for rearranging your space whenever inspiration strikes.

features.title: Safe glass top keeps you worry-free
features.text: Worry less about spills and scratches—a tempered glass surface offers lasting durability while keeping your table sleek and easy to clean.

features.title: Holds heavy items without worry
features.text: You can count on this table to hold your décor, everyday items, or that extra coffee cup—it’s built to support up to 20 kg without breaking a sweat.

features.title: Space-saving design for tight corners
features.text: Designed to maximise every square inch, our corner-friendly design slots neatly into unused spaces, adding smart storage without overwhelming the room.

features.title: Versatile black finish suits any style
features.text: Sleek, modern, and effortlessly elegant, our refined design blends smoothly into any décor style—from minimalist to contemporary—adding just the right touch of sophistication.

name: Vegas Tempered Glass Corner Table
